limitations: This audit does not rerun models, containers or tests.
Restricted blobs are hashed; hidden test contents, patches and raw model outputs are not emitted or independently interpreted.
Official classification is re-parsed from the retained final report; test-semantic correctness additionally relies on the already validated grader journal.
Solver isolation is checked against recorded base-only checkout and sandbox evidence; baked image contents are not exhaustively re-inspected.
Solved official results can coexist with an incomplete agent and a runtime step-cap failure.
Ledger includes active-cell charges; positive residual above finalized cells is expected and final exact reconciliation is deferred.
This is a terminal audit of a partial matrix; PASS_INTERIM denotes incomplete matrix coverage, not a process still running.
Paid guidance is bound to retained gateway prompt bytes and provider-send journals; no independent remote server input attestation is available.

terminal_partial_reconciliation.note: Task/grader capacity reservations can remain outstanding with zero outstanding dollars. Unfinished cells have no official result and are excluded from solve-rate denominators.
